title: alchemilla vulgaris subsp. obtusata
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. obtusata, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating menstrual issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Lady's Mantle include astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. obtusata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
